notes: Gen 8 singles: Leafeon's Attack beats its Special Attack, so its Photon Geyser is physical as it is used (`onModifyMove`), and Relicanth's Counter answers it with twice the damage. Showdown's Counter reads the category of the move as used (`getCategory` of the ActiveMove); the engine records it so for every move whose own `onModifyMove` changes it (DESIGN.md R-M8-174)
